item.title: The Local Train announce Bengaluru show at Phoenix Marketcity on 21 November
item.description: Hindi rock band The Local Train will play Phoenix Marketcity, Whitefield, Bengaluru on Saturday, 21 November 2026. Early bird tickets go live on District this Friday at 12 PM, priced at ₹999.

item.title: A tribute to The Local Train: unplugged covers night in Indiranagar
item.description: A covers band will perform songs of The Local Train at a pub in Indiranagar, Bengaluru on 24 Oct.
